title: The Garden of Ashvale
author: Ulyana Voss
blurb: Elodie Hartwell, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
